summary: 8 chipnet deployments; DEPOSIT GREEN (86420826, broadcast). Transfer blocked by the output-layout consistency requirement (documented fix: outputs mirror the pool layout; covenant output mapping i).

findings.finding: OP_1 carrier lock unspendable (BCH VM final-stack rule: depth must be 1) -> fixed to OP_DROP OP_TRUE (75 51)
Initial state roots = the hashed empty-tree roots (not zeros)
The state token category = the source txid (display); the instance = the reversed source txid; the VM's UTXOTOKENCATEGORY returns the reversed stored bytes
The pf6 txTopologyGuard requires input[i].vout == i -> pool layout verifier@0-5, carrier@6, state@7 (adapted the covenant's rolling check to match)
The 0x61 (ALL|FORKID|UTXOS) Schnorr sighash must include the source outputs' TOKENS

BLOCKER: the lane build's verifier unlocks are sighash-bound to the build's synthetic tx (1 OP_RETURN output, synthetic outpoints); they cannot be dropped into a real settlement tx. The real deposit requires the product's per-action witness pipeline (the kit port: design/04/05) that computes the unlocks against the actual settlement context.

The txTopologyGuard requires input[i].vout == i for EVERY action. The pool (genesis) outputs verifier@0-5, carrier@6, state@7 — the deposit's inputs satisfy this. But the DEPOSIT's OWN outputs used state@0 + verifier@1-6 + carrier@7 (the covenant's i+1 mapping) — the next action (transfer) spending those outputs has verifier inputs at vouts 1-6 → the guard (vout==i) FAILS. FIX: every action's outputs must mirror the pool layout (verifier@0-5, carrier@6, state@7, change@8); the state covenant's output mapping must be output[i] == input[i] (not i+1), the state output at 7, the binding output at 6. Requires a new pool (9th) since the deployed state covenant pins the old helper.
